content: Map-first listing aggregation apps use a decoupled event-driven pipeline: scraper/crawler layer (Playwright/HTTP clients) -> message queue (SQS/Kafka/Redis+BullMQ for lean setups) -> worker layer that normalizes and dedupes -> PostgreSQL+PostGIS for geospatial storage -> REST/API layer (Express/FastAPI) serving map+list UI. Small teams substitute Redis+BullMQ or node-cron for Kafka. Common build order: DB schema + API first, then scraper, then map UI, then real-time/notification layer.
